description: This PHP source file defines a 'Debug' class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class provides methods to track and log execution time for specific routes during the request lifecycle, specifically handling 'before' and 'after' events.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A controller class that manages debug tracing by recording timing information before and after route execution.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Records the current time before executing a route, storing it in the session data for later measurement.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time since 'before' was called for the route and logs the route name.
